multiplier.label: 5-hour multiplier
multiplier.description: Credits per USD of usage inside the 5-hour window, calibrated against /usage.

billing_day.label: Billing cycle start day
billing_day.description: Day of the month your Command Code subscription renews.

weekly_multiplier.label: Weekly multiplier
weekly_multiplier.description: Credits per USD of usage inside the weekly window.

month_multiplier.label: Monthly multiplier

usage_interval_minutes.label: Server usage interval (minutes)
usage_interval_minutes.description: How often the optional server usage command runs.
